document.title: Gate tests/ with clang-format; tighten the >= U+1F000 emoji classification
document.summary: Two follow-ups from #114: `scripts/clang-format.sh` now checks and formats `tests/`, with a one-time reformat; `vd_emoji_cluster` classifies codepoints above U+1F000 by Unicode 17 Emoji_Presentation instead of treating all of them as emoji.
document.why: [`tests/*.c` has lines over 120 columns and drifts from the style](source:s1), and [every codepoint at or above U+1F000 counts as emoji, including Mahjong tiles and text-default symbols like U+1F170](source:s1).

sources.title: [Claude] Gate tests/ with clang-format; tighten the >= U+1F000 emoji classification
sources.gist: Gate tests/ with clang-format and reformat once; classify emoji above U+1F000 by the Emoji property ranges like the table below it.

lookFor: Done differently: [the issue](source:s1) asks only to tighten the classification; the change also lets a following skin tone start a cluster, because without it fully qualified modifier sequences like U+1F575 U+1F3FB stop drawing as one emoji.
CI runs no C format check; only `scripts/agent-check.sh fast` calls `scripts/clang-format.sh check`, so the `tests/` gate is local.

parts.name: Emoji classification
parts.summary: `emoji_by_default` uses one sorted Unicode 17 Emoji_Presentation table for every codepoint, and the harness proves it.

parts.name: Format gate
parts.summary: `scripts/clang-format.sh` covers `tests/`, the docs say so, and the harnesses are reformatted once.

groups.title: Emoji_Presentation above U+1F000
groups.summary: `emoji_by_default` scans one sorted Emoji_Presentation table that now extends past U+1F000, and `vd_emoji_cluster` also starts a cluster when a skin tone follows, as the header comment now says.
lookFor: Subtle: `a` followed by U+1F3FB now clusters as {U+61, U+1F3FB}; no image exists, so only `a` draws and the swatch disappears, where before the swatch drew alone.

Subtle: U+1F3F3 U+200D U+1F308 without U+FE0F no longer clusters; the white flag and the rainbow each draw their own image through the first-codepoint fallback in `glyph_cache_get`, as text-default bases below U+1F000 already did.
Perf: the loop returns false at the first range whose start exceeds the codepoint, so ASCII stops after one comparison instead of scanning all 33 rows as before.

groups.title: Classification tests and Twemoji round-trip
groups.why: Proves the classifier against the issue's examples and every Twemoji 17.0.3 image.
groups.summary: New `expect_cluster` cases cover U+1F000, U+1F004, U+1F170 with and without U+FE0F, and skin-tone qualification, and the Twemoji round-trip stops inserting U+FE0F before a skin tone.
lookFor: The old round-trip wrote U+261D U+FE0F U+1F3FB for `261d-1f3fb.png`, which hid that U+261D U+1F3FB never clustered; the old classifier fails 36 Twemoji files under the new round-trip.

groups.title: clang-format covers tests/
groups.summary: Both `check` and `format` in `scripts/clang-format.sh` now find files under `src` and `tests`, and `AGENTS.md` and the `vitadeck-build` skill say the same.

groups.title: One-time tests/ reformat
groups.why: The new gate fails until the existing harnesses match `.clang-format`.
groups.summary: Whitespace and line-wrap changes only from `clang-format -i`, in its own commit `a46f4ed`; the reader can skip them.

commits.subject: fix(text): classify emoji above U+1F000 by Emoji_Presentation
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Codepoints at or above U+1F000 were all treated as emoji, including Mahjong
tiles and text-default symbols like U+1F170. Extend the Emoji_Presentation
table to Unicode 17 (Twemoji 17.0.3) instead. A following skin tone also starts
an emoji, since modifier sequences are fully qualified without U+FE0F.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
